title: Exact ReLU realization of tensor-product refinement iterates
summary: We study scalar dyadic refinement operators on R^2 of the form (Vf)(x,y) = sum_{(j,k) in Z^2} c_{j,k} f(2x-j, 2y-k), where only finitely many mask coefficients c_{j,k} are nonzero. Under a fixed support-window hypothesis, we prove that for every compactly supported continuous piecewise linear seed g:R^2->R, the iterates V^n g admit exact ReLU realizations of fixed width and depth O(n).
